params.body:
GLK uses the app at glk-transferor.on-forge.com in daily work: the Bouwsoft syncs run hourly and nightly, and workers fill in their sheets there. It is the production environment, but `elixir.json` declared it as staging. A staging address is a preview to Elixir, so an outage there does not count against production.

- `production` is now https://glk-transferor.on-forge.com. It is the same address, now declared as what it is.
- `gated: true`: every page sits behind the login (`/` redirects to `/aanmelden`). Without this flag Elixir judged the login screen as a public page and opened SEO tasks for it (basic tags 50, a missing description). Those tasks cannot be acted on.

The address stays an on-forge.com one until the app gets its own production domain. When it does, change this file in the same commit that moves the address.
params.title: Declare the live app as production, behind a login
